answer: Identity bonds with natural decay block bulk fakes. An applicant locks a $50 bond, signing with a quill on a ledger, like planting a cedar. Each epoch it decays 5% unless the agent does one peer-checked task. A forger making 1,000 identities locks $50,000, and idle fakes bleed $2,500 per epoch, like a reef cut off from tide, far above the $3,000 gain. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it whole by real work, and earns undiluted rewards.
